info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Human Resource Management By Recruitment Id-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of human resource management information associated with a specific recruitment ID. Users can access detailed insights regarding hiring processes, candidate evaluations, and staffing needs. It serves as a vital tool for HR professionals and recruitment teams to track and manage recruitment workflows efficiently. Typical use cases include querying recruitment data for reports or analysis, ensuring informed decision-making, and streamlining talent acquisition processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific recruitment resource using its unique identifier. It provides essential data relevant for managing recruitment processes and decision-making.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving recruitment details for a specific human resource management operation, identified by the unique RES-100045 reference. This body should conform to the specified JSON schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource data is returned.

GetHumanResourceManagementByRecruitmentI.description: This schema represents the request body for the Operations GET request in the Human Resource Management Recruitment module.

GetHumanResourceManagementByRecruitmentI.title: Recruitment Response Schema

requisitionId.description: The unique identifier for the job requisition.

positionTitle.description: The title of the position being recruited for.

departmentId.description: The unique identifier for the department associated with the requisition.

employmentType.description: The type of employment for the position (e.g., Full-time, Part-time).

location.description: The geographical location where the position is based.

targetStartDate.description: The anticipated start date for the position.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., Active, Inactive).

version.description: The version number of the requisition record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for tracking the request.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetHumanResourceManagementByRecruitmentI.description: This schema represents the response structure for recruitment operations.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request. This can be useful for tracking and logging the specific operation.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the request. This helps identify the source of the operation in a multi-application environment.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method, where a JSON Web Token (JWT) is provided in the authorization header. Clients must include a valid JWT token to authenticate requests to secured endpoints.
